title: Quanta Services, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026
excerpt: Cash and cash equivalents were $364.8 million and long-term debt, including current maturities, was $5.89 billion at March 31, 2026.
summary: Quanta's current quarterly filing confirms the PWR common-stock identity and reports USD 364.8 million cash, USD 689.7 million current debt maturities, USD 5.202 billion long-term debt, USD 10.653 billion current assets, USD 9.384 billion current liabilities, USD 7.405 billion goodwill, and USD 25.747 billion total assets at March 31, 2026. The filing describes electric-power, transmission, substation, distribution, interconnection, load-center, and communications infrastructure exposure and details fixed-price, labor, customer-payment, acquisition, goodwill, permitting, supply-chain, and project-delay risks.
